prReadback.body:
Closes #435. Owner acceptance for #276/#325 remains separate.

The Windows launcher refused a valid checkout reached through a directory junction or symbolic link because its identity helper compared two different path spellings and exited without output. The helper now compares the physical entry files, so either spelling emits the same identity and starts or reuses the matching gateway. Inert imports, configuration/runtime refusals, store checks and fingerprint contents stay intact.

The permanent Windows acceptance suite independently creates and verifies a real junction and directory symbolic link, then exercises helper output, native cold starts in both directions, same/cross-path warm reuse, wrong-store/settings refusals, exact process ownership and managed cleanup. Its test-only baseline commit `08e60a0ae6d6b7cae853326825365760166f3ad3` reproduced helper silence and native cold refusal through both genuine link types in [Windows CI](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/43787801176/job/133039259616); the unchanged original cases passed. The same native test bytes are included with the fix.

Validation before publication: 13/13 focused API tests, API types and scoped lint/format passed. The exact final built-helper regression failed its three intended assertions on old source and passed 2/2 on the candidate. Independent GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh native QA verified the built gateway through direct and junction paths, both cold starts, warm reuse and mismatch refusals, real TCP/file SQLite, both shell assets, two authenticated drains and independent process/port/store cleanup. Local directory-symlink creation returned EPERM before product execution; the hosted fixed-source Windows result below closes that local verification gap. The initial baseline diagnostic failure and exact-identity recovery, original lint failure and offline inspector corrections are retained.

Evidence: [baseline](docs/qa/2026-11-16-launcher-identity-baseline/README.md), [implementation](docs/qa/2026-11-16-launcher-identity-implementation/README.md), and [candidate native QA plus hosted old-source reproduction](docs/qa/2026-11-16-launcher-identity-candidate/README.md). This publication also archives the already merged #419 final CI/reviews/completion, without changing that implementation.

[Publication-head CI](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/43790735875) passed all four jobs on attempt 1 without retry: 9,619 tests / 41 skips and all 13 coverage floors; Browser 481 passes / one declared LIVE skip with zero retries; Windows 17/17 including both genuine link types; and all four distributed templates. The fixed-source hosted native run verified four cold starts, eight warm reuses, eight mismatch refusals and four managed drains. Optional strict routing performance was off; recorded frame p95 samples were 33.3–33.4 ms, so no strict-performance pass is claimed. The audit threshold passed with 8 low / 13 moderate advisories, and Windows uploaded no native artifact.

Claude Opus 5.5 xhigh formal scan 1 returned READY with no introduced blocker. Root dispositions and the full report are in the PR conversation; nonblocking follow-ups #493–#496 are parked. [Fresh GPT-6 Astra max final audit](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/492#issuecomment-6906437749) returned SIGN-OFF on this exact head/target; two of three formal scans are complete, with no unresolved blocker. Source candidate is `c75e277695dae260f0e14279cff8705bab84ef4c`, based on `9fa8b2474c7290adb800c5e26be73511095cae25`. The separate PR #460 owner merge hold and owner instance/store remain untouched. This PR does not install the batch or complete broader intent acceptance.

Follow-up from #433 and [the independent review](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/433#pullrequestreview-5815159382) of `b71c70605a7887557efda15ecaddf11988dcfdb0`.

Priority: P2. The helper's direct-execution check compares a resolved argv path with Node's realpathed module URL. A checkout reached through a directory junction/symlink can print no identity and cause an invalid-runtime/configuration refusal. The verified owner checkout uses a plain directory, so this does not block its rollout.

Acceptance:
- Canonicalize entrypoint detection or use explicit dispatch.
- Invocation through real and aliased checkout paths prints exactly one valid identity.
- Native cold/warm launch works through both paths, preserving wrong-store/configuration refusals.

Dedup: related #276. #344 is plugin-builder output ownership, a different component/root cause. No matching open or recently closed issue was found.

Original disposition: DEFER-ISSUE, non-blocking for #433. The owner subsequently dispatched this bounded work on 2026-11-13; it is now eligible in the fourth lane after runtime recovery. Launcher delivery order is #435, #436, #438, then #456. This issue does not complete owner acceptance on #276/#325.

Delivery: isolated implementation and cross-family review at xhigh after dispatch; independent QA must verify the listed touched systems. No owner service/store or secrets should be used for regression tests.
